verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 is hardware you run on your own infrastructure. It ships as a standard PCIe Gen5 card that integrates into existing servers, uses standard Ethernet you already own, and its docs cover running the Intel Gaudi Docker image on your own platform for training, inference and model serving. A community comment also notes the open OAM interface makes the devices owner-operable long-term. missing for 10: a detailed first-party on-prem installation and procurement guide in the evidence, and independent hands-on reports of self-hosted deployments.
